facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD launched its Programme for African Developing Island Economies on 24 July 2026 at the STC-TTIM Ministerial Segment in Abidjan, with the Comoros named among the seven member island states joining a framework that has digital transformation as one of six pillars.

facts.fact: Smart Africa names Comoros among the 19 signatories of the SATA Declaration on digital trust and cross-border interoperability.
Smart Africa said on 2026-03-24 that it welcomed this country as one of six recently joined member states, taking the Alliance to 42.

facts.fact: ANADEN says the Comoros is part of the Africa Cybersecurity Authority advisory body (ANCA) within the Smart Africa Alliance.
ANRTIC says it regularly and actively takes part in meetings organised by the African Union, Smart Africa and SADC.
ANRTIC says it has signed cooperation agreements with the regulators of Madagascar, Senegal, Morocco and Mauritius for technical collaboration and skills exchange; signing dates not given.

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Comoros signed the Smart Africa Trust Alliance declaration on 31 May 2024, as the 14th country to join.
The ATU ratification status table lists Comoros among the Union's member states, with only the 1977 PATU convention signed and no signature of the 1999 Constitution.
